gloss: to cut in; to interrupt; to butt in

definitions.gloss: to cut in line; to push in
definitions.explanation: To force one's way into a line or queue, bypassing others who were waiting.

definitions.gloss: to cut in (while driving); to merge aggressively
definitions.explanation: To suddenly move one's vehicle into traffic or another lane, often in a rude or dangerous manner.
To interject during a conversation or activity, often in an unwelcome manner.

examples.japanese: {列|れつ}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}まないでください。
{急|きゅう}に{車|くるま}が{割|わ}り{込|こ}んできて{危|あぶ}なかった。
examples.english: A car suddenly cut in and it was dangerous.

examples.japanese: {会話|かいわ}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}んですみませんが、{一|ひと}つ{質問|しつもん}があります。
examples.english: Sorry to interrupt your conversation, but I have a question.

examples.japanese: ずるい{人|ひと}が{列|れつ}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}んできた。
examples.english: A rude person cut into the line.

examples.japanese: {行列|ぎょうれつ}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}むのはマナー{違反|いはん}だ。
examples.english: Cutting in line is against etiquette.

examples.japanese: {割|わ}り{込|こ}まれて{順番|じゅんばん}を{抜|ぬ}かされた。
examples.english: Someone cut in and I lost my place in line.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{列|れつ}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}もうとした。
examples.english: The child tried to cut into the line.

examples.japanese: トラックが{無理|むり}やり{割|わ}り{込|こ}んできた。
examples.english: A truck forced its way in.

examples.japanese: {車線|しゃせん}{変更|へんこう}で{割|わ}り{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: Someone cut in while changing lanes.

examples.japanese: {渋滞|じゅうたい}{中|ちゅう}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}むのは{危険|きけん}だ。
examples.english: Cutting in during traffic is dangerous.

examples.japanese: {高速道路|こうそくどうろ}で{急|きゅう}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}まれると{怖|こわ}い。
examples.english: It's scary when someone suddenly cuts in on the highway.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}まないで。
{議論|ぎろん}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}んで{意見|いけん}を{述|の}べた。
examples.english: I broke into the discussion and stated my opinion.

examples.japanese: {電話中|でんわちゅう}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}んでくる{人|ひと}がいる。
examples.english: Some people interrupt while I'm on the phone.

examples.japanese: {大人|おとな}の{話|はなし}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}むのは{失礼|しつれい}だ。
examples.english: It's rude to butt into adult conversations.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{割|わ}り{込|こ}む → {割|わ}り{込|こ}まない (negative)
・{割|わ}り{込|こ}む → {割|わ}り{込|こ}んで (te-form)
・{割|わ}り{込|こ}む → {割|わ}り{込|こ}んだ (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {割|わ}る (to divide, split) + {込|こ}む (into)

The ～{込|こ}む pattern emphasizes forcing or pushing into something.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{列|れつ}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}む - to cut in line
・{車線|しゃせん}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}む - to cut into a lane
・{話|はなし}に{割|わ}り{込|こ}む - to butt into a conversation

REGISTER:
Generally has a negative connotation, implying rudeness or lack of consideration for others.
